To move the existing domain without deleting the old website, follow these steps:

Step 1 — Prepare the account
Open your Wix account, go to My Sites, and locate the new website.

Step 2 — Reassign the domain
1. Open the Dashboard for the new website.
2. Navigate to Settings → Domains.
3. Choose Connect Existing Domain (or Assign Domain).
4. Select the domain currently connected to the old website.
5. Confirm that the domain should be moved to the new website.

Step 3 — Choose the primary domain
If you are prompted, make the moved domain the Primary Domain.

Step 4 — Allow time for the change
The domain normally starts working within 15 minutes, although some cases can take up to 72 hours.

Important
The old website will not be deleted; it will simply lose its connection to the domain. Once the reassignment is complete, visitors using that domain will see the new website as the live site.
